relations: A hand pinches a carrot piece against the grater surface, generating friction during repeated rubbing strokes.
Up-and-down motion of the piece against the perforated surface keeps fine orange shreds lodged and visible.
Briefly lifting the piece pauses contact, while its return resumes the grating action on the surface.
The hand's grip shifts slightly with each stroke, maintaining the grater's constant diagonal orientation.
caption: The video captures a close-up of a stainless-steel box grater held diagonally, its perforated side facing right while the central surface is coated with fine orange shreds against a blurred maroon fabric. A hand enters from the top, pinching a small orange carrot piece and pressing it against the surface. The hand repeatedly rubs the piece up and down in short strokes, shifting between the upper and middle grating area. Midway through the excerpt the piece is briefly lifted out of view, leaving only the hand and the shred-covered grater, before returning to contact and the rubbing resuming. The grip and orientation shift slightly as the piece is repositioned each stroke. The lodged shreds remain visible and largely undisturbed, with no clear buildup or clearing in this window. The grater and background keep a constant orientation. The grating action is already underway on the first frame and still continues after the last.
